name: ui-liquid-stretch-switch
title: Liquid Stretch
description: Núm công tắc kéo dài ra như chất lỏng: mép trước lao đi, mép sau đuổi theo, núm dẹt lại khi giãn rồi rung nhẹ khi tới nơi.

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Track 160x56 r28. Knob pill 44x44. Each move (0.3 s on, 1.6 s off): the leading edge travels 104 px over 0.26 s power2.out, the trailing edge over 0.36 s power2.inOut starting 0.1 s later, so the pill stretches to ≈ 110 px; height shrinks by 12 px × stretch. On arrival (0.46 s after start) wobble w = 0.12 e^(−9 t) sin(34 t): height × (1 + w), width × (1 − 0.6 w). Track crossfades to accent with the knob centre. Params: travel (104 px) · lead (0.26 s) · trail (0.36 s, trễ 0.1 s) · wobble (0.12, 34 rad/s). The leading edge moves in 0.26 s (power2.out), the trailing edge 0.1 s later over 0.36 s, so the knob stretches; a wobble 0.12 e^(−9 t) sin 34 t on arrival.
